text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, drawn by a familiar tune, I 
peeked into the music room and found 
K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have a concert at the hospital soon. 
Everyone told me they'd 'love to hear an 
original piece too,' so I've been 
composing one, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Maybe I'm not that great at 
creative writing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If you'd like, would you give 
it a listen? It's still a work in 
progress, though.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list:
(Oh, nice song! But it sounds kind of sad, 
or rather—)

(Whoa, what a great song! But it sounds 
kinda melancholic, or—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It brought to mind a tragic classical 
piece. It was a melody that gripped one's 
heart with sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The song's level of completion is high. 
That's precisely why, as I was agonizing 
over what feedback to give—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who is it? Who's playing that dreary 
tune?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The tone of the song is dark. Far too 
dark. I felt as though I were deep at the 
bottom of the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, the BPM is too slow. 
Don't give me lukewarm numbers like 100 or 
200, let's aim for 1000 BPM.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san! You are spouting nonsense 
again...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... But, yeah. It is pretty gloomy as 
it is, so I gotta make it more pop.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's still far too dark. But it's starting 
to grow on me. Allow me to commend your 
unwavering, straight-and-narrow stance.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Why is that, I wonder? I feel 
like I'm pouring my feelings into it, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ............ May I ask just one thing?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Is the message you want to convey to the 
children through this song... an 
"apology"?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? No, that's not... That wasn't my 
intention at all."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: “...I didn't mean it like that. But—”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be that "that thing" deep inside 
me... is slipping into the song just a 
little?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She has a bit of a self-punishing 
mindset. That's why the music she makes 
ends up dark, too—and yet."
choice_data_list:
...Are those the feelings you truly want 
to convey?
...Is that what you really want to convey?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The feelings inside her can't just be some 
kind of "self-punishment." I knew that 
much myself.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...The feelings I want to convey, you 
ask...?
choice_data_list:
If it were you, Durandal, what kind of 
song would you make?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Me? If it were me... I would dedicate a 
song pledging allegiance to an unseen 
king.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I must convey my feelings and have my 
king wish for it as well. —To keep this 
sword at his side forever."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If I want to make everyone 
happy... Then I need to convey my own 
feelings, ones only I can give—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Reach them. Please reach them, my 
feelings. Even half is fine. Just a little 
is enough.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I want to return the favor. She always 
gives me that innocent smile— she always 
makes me smile—)

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! I love this song!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... thank goodness. ――Everyone is 
smiling.)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It was the best. I was in tears two 
seconds in. Past the one-minute mark, I 
pictured you filling a whole dome and 
cried all over again. Bravo.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You certainly have a rich imagination... 
Still, it truly was a wonderful song.
choice_data_list: Yeah! It really warmed my heart!
Yeah! It really warmed my heart!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... What a relief. It looks like my 
feelings got through to them.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I didn't understand. What meaning I 
should pour into it, what kind of song I 
should play."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Saying 'I'm sorry for always being on the 
receiving end'—there's no need to say that 
at all."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one receiving energy here. I made 
sure to tell them... 'Thank you.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad everyone helped me realize that. 
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hello. ...Huh? You had earphones in, what 
were you listening to?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, this is... your song! The one from 
the other day.

Yeah, this is... your song! The one from 
the other day.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Were you listening to me again? I'm 
glad you like it, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...It's kind of embarrassing. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Could it be... Ruby, the song 
you're playing...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies. If I am being too noisy, 
I will take my training elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. In fact, I'd 
love to hear more.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Hehe. I wonder if they liked my 
song...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while I was in the 
trainer's office, I received a call from 
K.S.Miracle.
choice_data_list:
Got it. Don't push yourself— just rest up 
and take it easy!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Yes, I'm sorry, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I pushed myself a bit too hard 
composing. I don't regret what I did, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Let's rest for now. And starting 
tomorrow, I have to make up for this――
